title: P-40 portable pure-water cart: hose-fed RO and DI | Aquemi
meta: The Aquemi P-40 is a portable RO/DI cart: sediment, catalytic carbon, one 4040 RO element and mixed-bed DI on a wheeled aluminium frame. Tap pressure does the work.
headline: Low-mineral water, made where the job is
lead: Reverse osmosis and deionization on one hose-fed cart. Connect a garden hose, open the tap and take low-mineral water from the outlet hose. No pump, tank or power supply: tap pressure does the work.

blocks.intro: Water passes the four stages in a fixed order. Three 3/4 in garden-hose connections: feed, product and concentrate.

stages.label: In
stages.d: A hose tap on a mains supply at 2.8 to 5.5 bar (40 to 80 psi); a pressure regulator above that.
5 µm, in a 10 × 2.5 in housing. Changed on pressure drop.
10 × 4.5 in housing, 1 µm. Removes chlorine and chloramine, which would damage the membrane.
One 4040 element in a 304 stainless steel housing. Concentrate leaves through a fixed 1.6 mm orifice, always open, with a ball valve to set recovery and flush.
10 × 4.5 in housing. Design target: 0 ppm TDS reading at the outlet while the resin has capacity.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: Low-mineral water, checked with a handheld TDS meter. A check valve keeps it from flowing back.

blocks.caption: Design values
blocks.intro: Performance figures are estimates for the stated conditions.

rows.m: Estimate; 1.4 to 5.2 L/min over 2.8 to 5.5 bar, 5 to 25 °C

rows.v: 33 to 50 %, set by the ball valve
Three 3/4 in garden-hose threads: feed, product, concentrate
About 28 kg dry, 41 kg with water
Anodized aluminium frame; 304 stainless RO housing; polypropylene filter housings

blocks.note: Not designed or certified for drinking water. Estimates are not guarantees of performance.

items.t: Vehicle, fleet and boat final rinse
items.d: Spot-free rinse at the yard or the dock, and solar panel washing.
Battery and coolant top-up, closed heating and chilled-water loop fill, pressure-washer and steam-cleaner feed.
Drinking water. Laboratory water grades. Dental units, autoclaves and sterilizers. Dialysis and pharmaceutical Purified Water. Continuous production duty.
Four pages: what it is, where it fits, how it works and the main figures. PDF, 1.4 MB, opens in a new tab.
Two pages: estimated flows by pressure and temperature, feed limits, connections, dimensions, materials, consumables and warranty. PDF, 1.1 MB.

items.a: No. The P-40 is not designed or certified for drinking water. For drinking water from air, see the AeroWell.

items.q: What do I need on site?
items.a: A hose tap on a treated mains supply at 2.8 to 5.5 bar (a regulator above that), three garden hoses, a drain for the concentrate hose and a handheld TDS meter to check the outlet. Hoses, regulator and meter are available as accessories.
A new membrane element and a cartridge set, packed separately. Hoses, the TDS meter and the pressure regulator are sold separately.

items.q: How do I know the resin is spent?
items.a: The outlet TDS reading rises. Change the DI cartridge. The carbon block and sediment filter have their own intervals.
A 12-month limited warranty on the frame, housings, valves, fittings and tubing. Cartridges and the membrane element are consumables and are not covered. Full terms on request.
Lead time about 4 weeks. Price on request: confirmed when you enquire.

cta.body: Tell us the product and where it will work. An engineer replies in writing with price and lead time.
include: Your tap pressure and water hardness, if known
